readme.markdown:
Social Fetch MCP

Let your coding agent fetch real social media and web data while it builds.

Documentation | API reference | Credits & billing

Server URL: https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp

## What Is This? Social Fetch MCP connects Cursor, VS Code, Claude, Windsurf, and other MCP clients to the Social Fetch API. Once installed, your agent can look up creators, fetch posts, search platforms, read web pages, check your balance, and read the Social Fetch docs from inside your editor. Use it when you want your agent to answer questions like: - "Find this TikTok creator and add their latest videos to my app." - "Pull the transcript for this YouTube video and summarize the sponsorships." - "Fetch this Instagram post, inspect the response shape, and wire it into my backend." - "Read the Social Fetch docs and choose the right endpoint for Reddit search." The MCP server itself is hosted by Social Fetch: ```text https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp ``` There is no local server to clone, build, or run from this repository. Clients connect to the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint and authenticate with OAuth in the browser. ## Why Use It? Agents are better when they can work with the same API your app uses. This gives them a direct, authenticated route to Social Fetch instead of making you bounce between docs, dashboards, scripts, and pasted JSON. - **Less setup:** call Social Fetch tools directly from your agent. - **Better answers:** the agent can search and read the live docs before choosing an endpoint. - **Real data in the loop:** test with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, Reddit, Spotify, web, and more from inside your editor. - **No API keys in editor config:** sign in once with OAuth. - **Same API everywhere:** MCP tools map to the public REST API, SDK, and docs. ## What You Can Fetch Social Fetch MCP exposes endpoint tools for: - TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, Telegram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Spotify data. - Profiles, posts, videos, comments, transcripts, search results, and platform-specific metadata. - Web markdown generation and AI-assisted web page questions. - Account identity and credit balance. - Social Fetch docs through `docs_search` and `docs_read`. Endpoint tools are metered like the REST API. Docs tools, `auth_whoami`, and `billing_balance_get` do not consume lookup credits. ## Requirements - A [Social Fetch](https://www.socialfetch.dev) account. - Credits for metered API routes. - An MCP client with remote Streamable HTTP support and OAuth, such as Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or MCP Inspector. ## One-Click Install - Install in Cursor - Install in VS Code - Install in Windsurf - [Open the hosted install page](https://www.socialfetch.dev/docs/integrations/mcp) Complete the **OAuth** browser flow after installing. If a one-click link does nothing - your editor is not installed, blocks custom URL schemes, or has no handler - use the manual setup below. ## Manual Setup ### Cursor Add this to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` or a project `.cursor/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "socialfetch": { "url": "https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp" } } } ``` Restart Cursor, open MCP settings, and complete the OAuth browser flow when prompted. ### VS Code Add this to `settings.json`: ```json { "mcp": { "servers": { "socialfetch": { "url": "https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp" } } } } ``` ### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add --transport http socialfetch https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp ``` Then run `/mcp` and authenticate Social Fetch to finish the OAuth flow. ### Claude Desktop Add a custom remote MCP connector with this URL: ```text https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp ``` Authorize Social Fetch when Claude prompts you. ### stdio-only Clients If your client only supports stdio MCP servers, bridge to the hosted server with `mcp-remote`: ```bash npx mcp-remote https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp ``` Point your client at the stdio process that command starts. ## Authentication Social Fetch MCP uses OAuth 2.1. Your MCP client handles the flow: 1. The client opens Social Fetch sign-in in your browser. 2. You sign in or create an account and approve access. 3. The client receives an access token and sends it with each MCP request. Do not paste a Social Fetch API key into MCP config. Credits are charged to the signed-in account, just like REST API requests. ## Tools `tools/list` exposes endpoint tools plus docs tools. Endpoint tool names match API operation IDs with dots replaced by underscores: | Tool name | API operation | | --- | --- | | `tiktok_profile_get` | `tiktok.profile.get` | | `instagram_post_get` | `instagram.post.get` | | `web_markdown_generate` | `web.markdown.generate` | | `auth_whoami` | `auth.whoami` | | `billing_balance_get` | `billing.balance.get` | Each endpoint tool's arguments mirror the matching API route parameters. See the [API reference](https://www.socialfetch.dev/docs/api) for the full endpoint catalog, argument schemas, response shapes, and pricing. Two docs tools are also available: | Tool name | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `docs_search` | Search Social Fetch docs across API, SDK, auth, errors, credits, and integrations. | | `docs_read` | Read a full docs page as markdown by pathname, such as `/docs/sdk`. | Recommended agent prompt: > Use the Social Fetch MCP docs to add TikTok profile lookup to this app with the TypeScript SDK. ## Example: TikTok Profile In Cursor, MCP Inspector, or another MCP client, call `tiktok_profile_get` with: ```json { "handle": "nike" } ``` The result contains the same `data` and `meta` envelope returned by the REST API. Check `meta.creditsCharged` and `meta.requestId` after metered calls. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | What to check | | --- | --- | | `401` on every call | Reconnect the server and complete OAuth again. Your token may be missing or expired. | | OAuth redirect loop | Finish signing in at Social Fetch, then approve access to return to your client. | | `402` responses | Your account is out of credits for the metered route. Top up in [Credits & billing](https://www.socialfetch.dev/docs/credits). | | No tools listed | Reconnect the server. If it persists, restart your MCP client. | | Client only supports stdio | Use `npx mcp-remote https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp`. | ## Repository Contents - `server.json` - MCP Registry metadata for the hosted remote server. - `examples/` - Copy-paste MCP client configuration snippets. - `assets/socialfetch-mark.svg` - Local copy of the Social Fetch mark (also served at `https://api.socialfetch.dev/mcp/icon.svg`). The implementation lives in Social Fetch's private API service, not in this public listing repository. ## Related - [Social Fetch MCP docs](https://www.socialfetch.dev/docs/integrations/mcp) - [Social Fetch API reference](https://www.socialfetch.dev/docs/api) - [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/social-freak-ltd/socialfetch-sdk) - [n8n community node](https://github.com/social-freak-ltd/n8n-nodes-socialfetch) ## License MIT (c) Social Freak Ltd

toolsPreview.name: github_trending_developers_list
toolsPreview.description: List trending GitHub developers for a language and time window. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: spotify_artist_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a Spotify artist by id or profile URL.

toolsPreview.name: spotify_album_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a Spotify album by id or album URL.

toolsPreview.name: spotify_track_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a Spotify track by id or track URL.

toolsPreview.name: soundcloud_profile_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a SoundCloud profile by handle.

toolsPreview.name: soundcloud_profile_tracks_list
toolsPreview.description: List a SoundCloud profile's tracks, newest first. Accepts a handle. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: soundcloud_track_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a SoundCloud track by URL.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_channel_get
toolsPreview.description: Get YouTube channel details by channel id, handle, or URL. Returns channel metrics and identifiers for snapshot baselines.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_channel_videos_list
toolsPreview.description: List long-form videos from a YouTube channel (not Shorts — use youtube.channel.shorts.list). Accepts a channel id or handle. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: youtube_channel_shorts_list
toolsPreview.description: List Shorts from a YouTube channel (not long-form videos). Accepts a channel id or handle. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: youtube_playlist_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a YouTube playlist by playlist id.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_community_post_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a YouTube community post by URL.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_search_list
toolsPreview.description: Search YouTube videos, channels, and playlists by free-text keyword (not hashtag — use youtube.search.hashtag.list for that). Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: youtube_search_hashtag_list
toolsPreview.description: Search YouTube content by hashtag (not free-text keyword — use youtube.search.list for that). Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: youtube_video_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a single YouTube video by URL. Channel lives under channel (not author); publish time is publishedAt.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_video_comments_list
toolsPreview.description: List comments on a YouTube video by URL. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: youtube_video_comments_analysis_get
toolsPreview.description: Analyze YouTube video comments. Accepts a video URL.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_video_comments_replies_list
toolsPreview.description: List replies to a YouTube comment. Accepts a from video comments. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: youtube_video_transcript_get
toolsPreview.description: Get the transcript for a YouTube video by URL.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_shorts_trending_list
toolsPreview.description: List currently trending YouTube Shorts. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: web_search_run
toolsPreview.description: Search the public web and return ranked organic results with snippets. Accepts a query. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: web_markdown_generate
toolsPreview.description: Convert a web page URL into clean markdown.

toolsPreview.name: web_ask_run
toolsPreview.description: Ask a natural-language question about a specific web page and get an LLM-generated answer. Accepts a URL.

toolsPreview.name: web_html_generate
toolsPreview.description: Fetch cleaned HTML for a web page URL.

toolsPreview.name: web_screenshot_capture
toolsPreview.description: Capture a screenshot of a public web page URL as a hosted image artifact.

toolsPreview.name: web_crawl_run
toolsPreview.description: Crawl a small set of web pages synchronously. Accepts a URLs. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

toolsPreview.name: web_extract_run
toolsPreview.description: Extract structured fields from a web page using a CSS selector schema. Accepts a URL and CSS schema.

toolsPreview.name: nl_ask_post
toolsPreview.description: Route a natural-language social-data question to the right lookup when you do not yet know the typed tool — prefer typed tools once the operation is known. Accepts a natural-language query.

toolsPreview.name: auth_whoami
toolsPreview.description: Get the authenticated API account for this session.

toolsPreview.name: billing_balance_get
toolsPreview.description: Get remaining credit balance before running large batches of metered tools.

toolsPreview.name: docs_search
toolsPreview.description: Search SocialFetch docs for API/SDK questions. For response fields use docs_read (defaults to outline). For cross-platform author/timestamp naming, search `field crosswalk` or read /product/ask-ai/field-crosswalk.

toolsPreview.name: docs_read
toolsPreview.description: Read a corpus page by docsPathname from docs_search. Defaults to mode=outline (compact field digest). Pass mode=full for Examples/SDK snippets. Accepts /docs/... and /product/... pathnames (including /product/ask-ai/field-crosswalk).

toolsPreview.name: monitors_sources_list
toolsPreview.description: List every public API operation Monitors can watch (Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit profiles and searches). Powers the monitor-creation flow.

toolsPreview.name: monitors_create
toolsPreview.description: Watch a social account or search and get a signed webhook when new content appears. Runs a synchronous baseline check on create — the response includes what's there right now, and you'll only get webhooks for items after that.

toolsPreview.name: monitors_list
toolsPreview.description: List the caller's monitors, optionally filtered by status.

toolsPreview.name: monitors_get
toolsPreview.description: Get one monitor by id.

toolsPreview.name: monitors_update
toolsPreview.description: Update a monitor's name, schedule, webhook endpoint, spend cap, or status (pause/resume).

toolsPreview.name: monitors_delete
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a monitor. Cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: monitors_trigger
toolsPreview.description: Queue an immediate check for an active monitor (async — returns once queued, not once the check finishes).

toolsPreview.name: monitors_events_list
toolsPreview.description: Pull API for a monitor's events — queryable regardless of webhook delivery configuration.

toolsPreview.name: monitors_checks_list
toolsPreview.description: The self-serve "why didn't I get a webhook" view — the last ~50 checks with outcome/credits/reason.

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a delivery target for monitor events. kind=http requires a public HTTPS url; kind=sink is a hosted test inbox with no url. The signing secret is returned once — store it now.

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_list
toolsPreview.description: List the caller's webhook endpoints (secret material never included).

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_get
toolsPreview.description: Get one webhook endpoint by id (secret material never included).

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_update
toolsPreview.description: Update a webhook endpoint's description or enable/disable it.

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_delete
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a webhook endpoint. Cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_test
toolsPreview.description: Send a realistic per-source sample event to a webhook endpoint right now — a live, synchronous delivery test.

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_rotateSecret
toolsPreview.description: Rotate the signing secret with a 24h overlap window — the old secret keeps working until it expires. The new secret is returned once.

toolsPreview.name: webhookEndpoints_deliveries_list
toolsPreview.description: List delivery attempts for a webhook endpoint. Supports `limit`, opaque `cursor` continuation, and optional `after` (ISO timestamp) to enter oldest-first tail mode for listeners.

toolsPreview.name: webhookDeliveries_redeliver
toolsPreview.description: Queue a manual redelivery for one delivery attempt (async).
